conferenceQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: All five have exact Core Action120feet/V,S,F, native rank8/base21RP/minimum class level15. Only Prism grants Druid/Mage/Wizard access; the other four grant Wizard access.

conferenceQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: WIS SAVE ENDS supplies a real ending save, but not its first opportunity or a separate initial-save procedure.

Preserve at least a meaningful interpretation of save ends rather than dropping it or placing the only save after automatic expiry. If the chosen state denies a whole Action, apply existing hard-control admission once on actual establishment; failed/prevented admission creates no deferred attempt or invented soft fallback. A purely soft immobilization does not spend the guard automatically.

conferenceQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: In-place control and one-round timing must resolve forced movement, moving support, flight, outside initiative and real ongoing events.
conferenceQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: keep actual clocks/life events running and use the chosen ordinary control components. B: explicitly suspend a finite named set of clocks as part of a fully authored temporal effect.
conferenceQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A unless actual source intent requires B. Preserve registered deadlines, poison/damage/death/recovery events, concentration, source lifetimes, extra-turn accounting and all prior costs. Ending/suppression resumes only lawful permissions, never refunds spent actions, resets clocks or replays missed events.

Distinguish seeing a body from hearing a voice, knowing a location, tremorsense or recognizing a false image. No universal gaze-aversion action or automatically closed-eye immunity beyond actual inability to see is imported. conferenceQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: The native rider is Paralyzed for1round, with accepted hard-control admission and condition-component immunity already defined.
